page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with no margin notes. Top right: printed page number 22. Below it, a small stray mark (see notes). Under the text: a signature line "L 5" at the left and the catchword "maximæ" at the right.

main_text.p: Sed quis hæc jam expediat Ænigmata? qui se prius ex Utroque Ordine mecum una ab his furoribus subtraxerant, Desertores Parlamenti habiti sunt, & in perpetuum exclusi, qui vero permanebant, & beneficio Tumultuum utebantur, hi unici erant Senatores: Contra jam, Locum suum deserentes & profugi secum unà Authoritatem Parlamentariam auferunt, debacchantur in Tumultus, & se vi armatâ restituunt, dum qui manent adhuc in statione sua fixi Hortatores Tumultuum audiunt, libertatisque & Honoris Parlamentarii Proditores.

Adeo ultra Leges omnes & Regulas Vis pollet; dumque magis quid in præsens expediat, homines quàm Conscientiam spectent & illam Normam Justitiæ immutabilem, fit plærumque ut dum aliorum Judices sedeant scipfor[?] maximè condemnent.
Jam Tumultus grande Crimen! jam Authores eorum & Fautores prodigiosæ Audaciæ rei, nuper animo in Parlamentum benevolo, & necessarii valde adjutores.
Ita (quod olim narratur de illo Præfule Germano à forecibus & muribus interemptò) acris sequitur vindicta & deprehendit eos, qui se Numero securos, & obsequio in Populum munitissimos existimabant.
In quos jam Leges nil possunt, Deus propriis ipsorum scelerinbus[?] & manibus etiam castigabit.
Hoc interim Divinæ Justitiæ opus Ipse

page.notes: Page number 22 is printed at top right. A small stray mark sits under it; it is not text and is left out. The running head ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΑΙΚΗ. is printed at the top of the page. Left edge: small marks and fragments from the neighbouring page and show-through, left out. Doubtful readings: "scipfor" (ends the line before "maximè"; the reading is uncertain), "scelerinbus" (printed form uncertain, possibly sceleribus). "Vtroque" is printed with V and is given as Utroque. The last line "Hoc interim ... Ipse" is followed by the signature and catchword line "L 5 ... maximæ".
